selection_rule: malignant recall >= 80% of the 95 wild cancers, then max combined correct across the 564 benchmark + 199 wild + 50 third-source films

wild_199.note: V21 scored 98/199 (49.2%) on the identical protocol

independent_wikimedia_50.note: third source unseen by any model; V21 scored 11/50

band_table: checkpoints/uncertainty_bands_v25.json (5.3% flagged, 46.7% error inside, 30.4% of errors caught, reliable band 95.0%)
mechanism: error anatomy showed 93/100 wild errors were classification failures on named entity families; V24 fine-tunes on 121 real-world images of exactly those entities, V25 adds 38 harvested radiographs of the same diagnoses
caveat: the 50-film third-source pool is 46 benign / 4 malignant so it tests generalisation, not cancer recall; the held-out 78-film slice shares a source domain with the training slice
